<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0403-02-46" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3811">mu tra</rs> na re de bzhin gshegs pa las gyis mi khyab pa dang phul 3 yino
            || de ltar na byang ye la dang par sangs rgyas kyang logs su smos par 'gyur zhe na | mi
            'gyur te de'i rgyud kun gzhi'i rigs pa na du gtogs pas snga ma de dag <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="141b5"/> du
            'dus pa'i phyir logs su mi 'gras la || de bzhin gshegs pa ni laM 2 ga dang yang ma 'brel
            bas logs su smos pa yin shes <expan>zer ro</expan> || 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3921">tho</rs> de de byang sel dang sangs pa rgyas 2 te nang cag
            bcos lnga yino zhes zer te | thob myed pa'i gang zag ni tsaM dam pa can du byas nas bcu'
            1 yin la | yum ba chan du byas nas su bcu' po lnga yin zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">skyabs</rs> <expan>zer ro</expan> ||</seg></TEI>
